analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains stuck in neutral territory, failing to break out of oversold conditions, while the MACD histogram continues its worsening trend, indicating persistent selling pressure. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.68x the 5-day average, signaling a lack of directional conviction. After holding for 46 days and achieving a +9.0% gain, current indicators suggest a lack of upward momentum.
